messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty autopage fired for host rwd-gpu-prod-17 (pager: HOST_UNREACHABLE). PD: https://pd.example/incidents/INC-87214

incident-bot: Alert details: node not responding to kubelet healthcheck, kernel messages show repeated oops + soft lockups, last heartbeat lost 2829981099. Autopage policy: oncall -> tier2-hardware -> eng-platform.

alex: acked the page (oncall). I'm on it.

alex: quick check: any active customer 5xx spikes? @support-ops-bot run quick check for 5xx on /v1/generate in last 10m please.

support-ops-bot: Summary: minor 504 increase for tenant "BrightBox" (~1.2% of their requests), global 5xx unchanged. No SLO-wide breach.

maria: thanks. I'm going to pull the node state and serial console. tagging @jim for hardware.

alex: running: ```kubectl describe node rwd-gpu-prod-17```
alex: ```Name:               rwd-gpu-prod-17
Roles:              gpu
Conditions:
  KubeletReady     False  kubelet is not ready: container runtime not responding
Non-terminated Pods:  86
Allocated resources:   huge (GPUs attached)
Taints:             node.kubernetes.io/unreachable:NoSchedule```

maria: serial console snapshot (most recent):
```
[  154.123456] NVRM: GPU at 0000:3b:00.0: RmInitAdapter failed! (0x32)
[  154.123457] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt
[  155.000000] Rebooting in 10 seconds..\n```

jim: oncall-hw here. looks like a firmware/driver-level OOPS leading to kernel panic + automatic reboot loop. Could be NVMe/GPU firmware interplay. I'll try to get IPMI console attached and pull SEL.

tara: @alex if node is in reboot loop we should evacuate pods ASAP from that rack to avoid cascading load. Suggest cordon + drain with eviction policy for GPUs.

alex: agreed. Performing cordon/drain now.

alex: `kubectl cordon rwd-gpu-prod-17` -> success.
alex: `kubectl drain rwd-gpu-prod-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` -> starting eviction. Estimated time ~6-8m for large GPU pods.

maria: notifying support & affected tenants. Drafting customer message: "We're investigating a host-level outage impacting a small subset of Dedicated GPU capacity in us-west-2; we may see transient increased latency or occasional 504s. Engineers are evacuating workloads and performing host recovery."

support-ops-bot: Notification queued to tenants: BrightBox, VizLabs. Severity: P2.

jim: attached IPMI session, SEL shows repeated thermal trip + PCIe reset events. Running `ipmitool sel list` now. If it stays in a kernel panic loop after drain, we'll power-cycle via BMC and hold.

alex: drain finished, 86 pods rescheduled. No evictions failed.

maria: good. Impact check: BrightBox reported increased latency in their telemetry but no hard failures. We paged their account lead with context.

jim: initiating power cycle: `ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.12.45.17 -U admin -P <redacted> chassis power cycle`

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: INC-87214 -> acknowledged by alex. Escalation to tier2-hardware assigned to jim.

(2m later)

jim: host came back up, but kernel oops still present in dmesg after boot. Boot log extract:
```
[    8.512345] nvidia: module license 'NVIDIA' taints kernel.
[    8.523456] nvme nvme0: timeout waiting for completion
[    8.600000] kernel: BUG: soft lockup - CPU#3 stuck for 22s
```

maria: since hardware restart didn't fully resolve, recommend we keep node cordoned and mark for maintenance. I'll create a maintenance ticket to isolate to rack and schedule firmware downgrade/driver roll-back with platform.eng.

alex: agree. Marking node `schedulable=false` and adding tag `maintenance_needed:gpu-fw` in inventory.

alex: updating PD incident: adding note about tenant impact and that pods evacuated successfully. PD: https://pd.example/incidents/INC-87214

tara: handoff: my oncall shift starts at 2830000000, leaving detailed runbook in the incident ticket. Steps remaining: 1) Hold node cordoned, 2) Escalate to firmware owners (eng-platform), 3) Replace/repair hardware if root-cause confirmed, 4) Verify tenants' performance after nodes in rack drained.

maria: I'll open a follow-up with eng-platform and tag @platform-fw. Also uploading serial console logs + SEL to the ticket.

alex: summary for handoff: autopage -> host unreacheable; acked; cordon+drain done; power-cycle attempted; node still shows kernel oops; pods rescheduled with no failures; minor tenant latency for BrightBox; escalation to tier2-hardware and eng-platform opened. PD INC-87214 updated; maintenance ticket RWD-MNT-458 created.

jim: assigning RWD-MNT-458 -> hardware team queue. Leaving IPMI console attached.

tara: thanks team. If anything changes ping oncall channel and escalate back up. :thumbsup:

alex: handing off to tara for next steps. I'll stay reachable for 30m if followups are needed.

(END)
